stepInstructions: Open the brc20 workspace and choose Deploy. Ticker, supply, and mint limit are permanent once deployed.
Fill ticker, total supply, and per-mint limit. Indexers enforce ticker rules first come, first served.
Review the deploy cost. Deployment is one inscription: fee plus postage, with the service fee shown if it applies.
